summary: Makita's cordless saw manuals print a clean chain table: chain type (90PX or 91PX), drive-link count, bar part number, pitch and gauge for each bar length. The catch is that two chain types share one pitch and differ only in gauge (.043″ vs .050″), so the gauge on your bar decides which loop fits.
